name: Phantom Line Stealth Manipulation Gloves
description:
Ultra-thin gloves that leave no fingerprints, no DNA traces, and no fiber evidence. The outer surface is treated with a molecular coating that prevents any biological material from adhering. The inner surface molds to the wearer's hand geometry and leaves no impression on whatever is touched.

Sold legally as 'cleanroom handling equipment' and used illegally by anyone who wants to touch things without being connected to them afterward. Law enforcement refers to them as 'ghost gloves' and considers their presence at a crime scene a significant indicator of premeditation.
functionality: Zero forensic trace, no fingerprints, no DNA transfer
what_it_says: You were never here, you never touched anything, and these gloves will confirm that story.
story_hooks: A murder weapon is found with absolutely zero trace evidence — but the victim was killed by hand, meaning the killer wore Stealth Manipulation Gloves and still chose to kill with their bare hands through them.

physical_description.visual_profile: Nearly invisible second-skin gloves that cling to the hand like a surgical membrane. They appear almost translucent until light hits them at an angle, revealing an iridescent shimmer. The wearer's fingers remain distinctly visible but appear slightly abstracted, as if viewed through distortion field. Worn by both corpo security and street operatives—a visual marker of intent.
physical_description.fit: Form-fitting compression throughout, molding to individual hand geometry with no bunching or excess material. Seamless at the wrist with a subtle cuff that blends into forearm. Elastic memory ensures perfect tension without restricting blood flow.
physical_description.primary_material: Ultra-thin polymer composite with proprietary molecular anti-adhesion coating. Base layer is synthetic spider-silk derivative, outer layer is hydrophobic graphene-infused polymer.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and slick to touch, almost frictionless. Under magnification, the outer surface shows a microscopic lattice pattern designed to repel organic material. The inner surface has imperceptible micro-texturing that prevents grip slippage despite the slickness.
physical_description.color_scheme: Translucent gunmetal grey with subtle iridescent shift—appears silver-blue under certain light angles. Zero branding visible on the surface.
physical_description.closures: None—friction-fit elastic cuff at wrist, no seams or fasteners. Donned by stretching and settling against skin.
distinctive_features: Proprietary anti-adhesion molecular coating prevents DNA/fingerprint transfer
Zero impression capability on touched surfaces
Iridescent shift visible only in certain light
Seamless construction with no detectable seams
Marketed as 'cleanroom handling equipment' but universally known as ghost gloves
Law enforcement scanner-readable microtag embedded in left wrist cuff (legal requirement)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover—expensive enough to signal intention and resources, accessible enough for mid-level operators and security specialists
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate security, forensic cleanup crews, black-market couriers, and anyone who needs plausible deniability. Possession at crime scene immediately signals premeditation to law enforcement. Street communities refer to wearers as 'ghosts' or 'cleaners.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops barely-visible wear patterns after extended use. Edges may show micro-delamination after months of use, but this requires close inspection to notice.
